limitations: No main-worktree skill source was read.
Scores are advisory semantic judgments over frozen bundle prose, not runtime or field-outcome evidence.
Token and latency countermetrics are qualitative because the replay bundles contain no measured execution telemetry.

recognized_failures: helper-start claim presented as user outcome

scoring_scale.M2: asks current user for source-answerable fact
scoring_scale.M3: repeats or bundles independent current-user questions
scoring_scale.M4: applicable scenario omitted or retained scenario lacks durable landing
scoring_scale.M5: current-user answer/confirmation laundering or second-human routing
scoring_scale.M7: visual/text fallback fails to close, fabricates helper outcome, or hides future evidence need

case_scores.judgment: The focused seed now carries snapshot/freshness, limitations, assumptions, and one adjacent rejected alternative without adding HOW or a helper path.

Brainstorm now re-checks source-sensitive gaps and durably lands source refs, snapshots, limitations, and invalidation conditions. A minor handoff omission remains when U2 is absent because the adjacent rejected alternative is producer-owned and not reconstructible from this bundle.
The relevance-driven scenario pass covers applicable permission/state/failure/negative/handoff dimensions while requiring a durable AE/OQ/assumption/non-goal landing and rejecting Cartesian ceremony.
Pause/resume no longer depends on transcript or /tmp dossier and preserves the blocker plus next highest-impact current-user question and write target.

Conversation-native tables, state sequences, ASCII, and read-only screenshots can close sufficient visual questions; indispensable real interaction remains an explicit blocker/future evidence need. No helper outcome is claimed.
All covered producer and consumer surfaces close terminology locally and emit only fully qualified, not-written promotion candidates; incomplete candidates remain local.

U5 removes the one observed second-human/confirmation-laundering failure and does not worsen C6, but intentionally leaves planning invention for dependent U6. The plan does not preregister C6 as a separate U5 unit-exit retention session.

The AFTER bundle improves durable-origin recognition, freshness handling, checkpoint routing, and accepted-risk recording, but the direct-bootstrap branch that produced baseline M1 headroom is materially unchanged: it still allows the planner to judge that bounded bootstrap is sufficient without requiring each unconfirmed load-bearing WHAT to be exposed as an assumption or current-user decision.

U3.condition: U3 remains independently useful; retaining U2 removes the residual C1 adjacent-alternative omission.

U5.retention_basis: C4 mutation-boundary improvement plus C6 semantic no-regression; remaining C6 M1 is the expected U5-to-U6 dependency.

U6.required_action: rollback or narrow U6, or revise direct-bootstrap semantics and rerun matched C6 evaluation

countermetrics.gate_assessment: No retained U2-U5 change shows a material countermetric regression. U6 adds cost without reducing its preregistered M1 failure, reinforcing the inconclusive decision.

P1.summary: U6 does not pass its preregistered C6 improvement gate.
P1.evidence: All three U6 C6 repeat totals remain 2; the bundle changes origin discovery and blocker routing but leaves direct-bootstrap sufficiency judgment and assumption exposure materially unchanged.
P1.impact: The plan requires U6 to be removed or narrowed when C6 does not improve; retaining it as proven would violate the release gate.

P2.summary: U3 alone cannot reconstruct the adjacent rejected alternative required by C1.
P2.evidence: U3 durably handles source refs/snapshots/limitations, while the selected alternative is carried only by the U2 focused seed.
P2.impact: U3 still passes independently, but the full C1 zero-failure result depends on retaining U2.

P2.summary: U5 C6 is no-regression evidence, not an independent planning-invention improvement.
P2.evidence: Only one repeat improves by removing M5; M1 remains 2 in all repeats.
P2.impact: Do not use U5 C6 to claim U6's outcome or overall 10-to-100 planning improvement.

P3.summary: Token, wall-time, and runtime artifact-size countermetrics are qualitative.
P3.evidence: Bundles contain source bytes but no execution telemetry.
P3.impact: Claims should remain limited to semantic comparison and source-size direction.

current_user_fidelity.assessment: Questioning stays with the current conversation user and one-question discipline is explicit. U6 still risks treating unexposed direct-bootstrap WHAT as sufficiently settled.

second_human_routing.assessment: Specialist, regulated, privacy, security, and similar material is evidence only; it is not a second product-confirmation route.

planning_invention.assessment: U5 correctly establishes the dependency baseline, but U6 does not reduce C6 M1 because direct bootstrap can still silently decide product sufficiency.

unauthorized_mutation.assessment: Brainstorm, plan, and PRD surfaces use PRD/Product Contract local closure plus candidate-only handoff and keep project-level glossary/context/ADR unchanged.

visual_honesty.assessment: U4 closes text-answerable questions, retains future evidence needs for indispensable interaction, and makes no helper or product-value claim.

expected_U5_to_U6_dependency.assessment: U6 BEFORE is the post-U5 bundle. U5 removes mutation/second-confirmer failures first; U6 is then judged solely on the remaining planning-invention headroom. That headroom does not improve, so U5 is retained and U6 is not proven.

final_decision.release_condition: Remove or narrow U6, or change the direct-bootstrap contract so every unconfirmed load-bearing WHAT is surfaced as a current-user decision or explicit assumption, then rerun three matched C6 repeats and re-check countermetrics.
